request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Siltjaw Crocodile".

Creative brief
Name: Siltjaw Crocodile
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A waterline ambusher that erupts forward and sends mud waves to both sides.
Body and silhouette: Long low crocodilian body with a broad jaw, plated back, and thick sweeping tail.
Signature features: Silt-covered armor ridges, reed growths, and pale eyes above the head.
Palette and materials: Mud brown, algae green, dark olive, and dull ivory.
Movement personality: Still, explosive, and brutally direct.
Attack concept: Submerges beneath a visible ripple, lunges along a marked lane, and sends short mud-wave fans perpendicular to the lunge.
Directional details: The final tail plate is chipped on the left side.
Avoid: Realistic camouflage that hides the sprite, dinosaur spikes, oversized boss scale.
